title: One drought, four lenses
back: Geography: rain, soil · History: past droughts · Politics: relief, who decides · Economics: crops, prices.

title: Social Science, defined
back: Keep the word **systematic**. It explains why and how, not just what and where.

title: Natural sciences vs Social Science
back: Physics, Chemistry, Biology study the natural world. Social Science studies institutions, cultures and human interaction.

title: The journey of your roti
back: Farm → mill → truck → shop → plate. Each step involves places, people, decisions and money: everyday social science.

title: Where historians find evidence
back: Literary (texts) · archaeological (remains) · epigraphic (inscriptions) · numismatic (coins) · scientific (carbon-14, genetics).

title: Kshiti, Jal, Pāvak, Gagan, Samīr
back: Panchamahābhūtas: earth, water, fire, sky (space), air. Five elements as one connected system: an early systems view of nature.

title: Why study Social Science?
back: Understand everyday systems · respect diversity · act as an informed citizen · see how past choices shape the future.
